newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices mixed at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices mixed at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were mixed at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 10,556 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 97.9 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron rose 3.0 percent, 21 micron rose 0.5 percent, 22 micron fell 1.5 percent, 23 micron fell 3.4 percent, 24 micron fell 3.2 percent and 25 micron fell 4.5 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies fell 0.2 percent, Merino lambs rose 0.4 percent and Merino locks rose 2.1 percent.
The offering included 1,816 bales of other White Wools, 1,576 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 2,167 bales of Lesotho and 1,208 bales of coarse and coloured.

Of the 353 bales of 20 micron offered, 97.5 percent was sold. Of the 1,386 bales of 21 micron offered, 99.0 percent was sold. Of the 1,633 bales of 22 micron offered, 98.8 percent was sold. Of the 1,295 bales of 23 micron offered, 97.5 percent was sold and of 547 bales of 24 micron offered, 89.4 percent was sold. All of the 25 micron bales were sold.
The next sale will take place on April 23, when about 10,000 bales will be on offer.
